A2_software_inventory.query: SELECT name, version, install_date, install_source, publisher FROM programs ORDER BY name;

A2_os_version.query: SELECT name, version, build, platform, arch, codename FROM os_version;
A2_os_version.description: A.2.4(b)(f) — OS version and EoL status

A2_hardware.query: SELECT computer_name, cpu_brand, cpu_physical_cores, physical_memory, hardware_model, hardware_vendor, hardware_serial FROM system_info;

A2_network_interfaces.query: SELECT interface, address, mask, type FROM interface_addresses WHERE type != 'other';

A3_disk_encryption.query: SELECT name, encrypted, type, uid FROM disk_encryption;

A4_antivirus.query: SELECT name, state, signatures_up_to_date, type FROM windows_security_products WHERE type = 'Antivirus';
A4_antivirus.description: A.4.4(a)(b)(c) — Antivirus present, active and up to date

A4_firewall.query: SELECT domain_enabled, private_enabled, public_enabled FROM windows_firewall_rules LIMIT 1;

A4_firewall_profiles.query: SELECT name, enabled, default_inbound_action, default_outbound_action FROM windows_firewall_settings;

A5_local_accounts.query: SELECT uid, username, description, type, is_hidden FROM users WHERE type = 'local' ORDER BY username;

A5_local_admins.query: SELECT gu.username, gu.uid FROM user_groups ug JOIN groups g ON ug.gid = g.gid JOIN users gu ON gu.uid = ug.uid WHERE g.groupname = 'Administrators';

A5_password_policy.query: SELECT minimum_length, password_history_size, max_age, min_age, complexity FROM password_policy;

A5_account_lockout.query: SELECT lockout_threshold, lockout_duration, lockout_observation_window FROM account_policy_data;

A5_rdp_status.query: SELECT name, data FROM registry WHERE path = 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' AND name = 'fDenyTSConnections';

A6_autorun_disabled.query: SELECT name, data FROM registry WHERE path LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' AND name = 'NoDriveTypeAutoRun';

A6_screen_lock.query: SELECT name, data FROM registry WHERE path = 'HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Control Panel\Desktop' AND name IN ('ScreenSaverIsSecure','ScreenSaveTimeOut','ScreenSaveActive');

A6_guest_account.query: SELECT username, uid, type FROM users WHERE username = 'Guest';

A6_smb_version.query: SELECT name, data FROM registry WHERE path LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters' AND name IN ('SMB1', 'SMB2');

A6_startup_items.query: SELECT name, path, args, source, status, username FROM startup_items;

A7_windows_updates.query: SELECT hotfix_id, description, installed_on FROM patches ORDER BY installed_on DESC LIMIT 50;

A7_update_settings.query: SELECT name, data FROM registry WHERE path LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU' AND name IN ('AUOptions','ScheduledInstallDay','ScheduledInstallTime');
A7_update_settings.description: A.7.4(a) — Windows Update automatic update policy

A8_backup_jobs.query: SELECT name, status, last_run_time, next_run_time, enabled FROM scheduled_tasks WHERE name LIKE '%backup%' OR name LIKE '%Backup%';

A8_vss_snapshots.query: SELECT id, set_id, create_time, volume FROM shadow_copies ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10;
A8_vss_snapshots.description: A.8.4(d) — VSS shadow copies (local backup indicator)
